findings.message: The client-supplied name is interpolated into a shell command run with shell=True, so a name such as `x.png; rm -rf /` runs arbitrary commands on the server; the same unchecked name joined onto UPLOAD_DIR also allows path traversal (`../../etc/passwd`) for both the read and the thumbnail write. Pass an argument list without a shell and accept only a server-chosen name, or resolve the path and verify it stays inside UPLOAD_DIR.
make_thumbnail is new behaviour with no test, while the contributing guide asks for a test with every change in behaviour.
